column1: # Rows are appended only by `tests/test-manifest.sh approve <test> '<note>'`.
# An exception row excludes the test's declared cost_s from its tier's budget
# sum (and from the quick budget when quick=y), covering a deliberate overage.
#   test   full ctest test name (must exist in test-manifest.tsv)
#   tier   the test's tier (must match test-manifest.tsv)
#   note   why the overage is accepted (single line, no tabs)

column4: New uki/grub single-source-of-truth baseline guard (parse round-trip + repair consumption); quick budget was already at 120 before this 2s fast test.
